description: Defines the ocudu::nr_cell_identity class for representing and manipulating 36-bit NR Cell Identities as per 3GPP specifications, including creation, parsing, and extraction methods.

classes.name: nr_cell_identity
classes.description: Represents a 36-bit NR Cell Identity with methods for creation, parsing, and extracting gNB and sector IDs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an NR Cell Identity from a 64-bit value or from gNB ID and sector ID.

methods.name: parse_hex
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal string into an NR Cell Identity.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the internal 64-bit value of the NR Cell Identity.

methods.name: sector_id
methods.description: Extracts the Sector ID from the NR Cell Identity.

methods.name: gnb_id
methods.description: Extracts the gNB-DU ID from the NR Cell Identity.
